EU Residence Permit Application Form

Field 1: Full Name — John Smith
Field 2: Nationality — British
Field 3: Date of Birth — 15 March 1990
Field 4: Address in Germany — Hauptstrasse 12, 10115 Berlin
Field 5: Purpose of Residence — Employment (IT Specialist)
Field 6: Permit Duration — 5 years (2026-2031)

This permit is issued under Section 18 of the German Residence Act (Aufenthaltsgesetz) and is valid throughout the Federal Republic of Germany. The holder is entitled to seek employment without additional work permits. This document must be renewed 6 weeks before expiry.

search.text: Die Verlängerung eines Aufenthaltstitels richtet sich nach §8 AufenthG. Der Antrag muss mindestens 6 Wochen vor Ablauf der Gültigkeit gestellt werden.
Section 18 of the German Residence Act (Aufenthaltsgesetz) grants residence permits for qualified professional employment. Holders are entitled to work without a separate work permit.
